This PR is part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* #48026
* #48025
* #48024

* #48022

* __->__ #48005
* #48004
* #48003
* #48002
* #48001

## Motivation

A speculative draft fused into the unified pool used to be placed by its layer kind; draft layers whose retention differed from the target's either got a private draft pool or were forced into a band that does not match their lifetime. This PR places draft KV by retention lifetime: a draft layer shares the target sub-pool with the same lifetime, and gets its own band otherwise. It also makes window reclamation independent per window and derives the draft's KV coordinates from its attention execution (DCP width, backend).

## Modifications

- Placement: `mem_cache/layout/fused_draft.py`, `kv_cache_configurator.py`, `kv/plan.py`, `kv/alloc/runner_ids.py`, `kv/alloc/id_space.py`, `unified_draft_pool.py`: draft bands are planned by retention lifetime; fused draft views share the target's storage arena.
- Allocation: `kv/alloc/{chain,band,pricing,interim}.py`, `kv/storage.py`, `prefill_budget.py`: independent windows are reclaimed for cleanup and admission; physical reservation scopes and takes cover every chain band.
- Execution: `configs/attention_execution.py`, `layers/attention/{flashinfer_mla_backend,triton_backend}.py`, `kv/layout/{mha,mla,page}.py`, `layout/token_major.py`, `models/dflash.py`, `speculative/multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2.py`: draft KV coordinates come from the attention execution (replicated vs DCP-sharded).
- HiCache: `managers/cache_controller.py`, `hybrid_cache/hybrid_cache_controller.py`, `kv/memory/host_backing.py`, `hicache_storage.py`, `storage/umbp/umbp_store.py`: storage rank replication is decided per view; the `"file"` storage backend uses the page-envelope host pool (it reads and writes whole pages); a single-pool envelope host is sized from that pool's capacity under `--hicache-ratio` rather than from the whole region.
- Tests: draft placement, DCP capacity, HiCache DCP/identity, multiwindow placement, tri-pool and radix-cache tests under `test/registered/unit/`.

**Behavior changes:**
- Under `--enable-unified-memory`, a draft whose fusion into the unified pool is declined now fails at startup with the reason (`invalid unified draft storage declaration: ...`) instead of falling back to a private draft pool. Examples: a Triton draft attention backend with `--dcp-size > 1` (select a replicated draft backend or disable unified memory); recurrent draft layers without a target recurrent-state band; draft prefill and decode backends with different DCP widths. Some DSPARK/DFLASH configurations that started on `main` this way are refused; a fix is planned in a follow-up.
- HiCache with `--hicache-storage-backend file` uses the page-envelope host layout under unified memory.

## Accuracy Tests

Serving validation was run at the **top of this 26-PR stack** (the cumulative change), not at this PR's head. Software: torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10. GSM8K is few-shot, 500 or 1319 questions as noted; `main` is the same commit the stack is based on, same flags.

| Hardware | Model | Configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, `--enable-unified-memory` (rebased stack) | 0.954 (1319 q) | 0.950–0.954 |
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP1, `--enable-unified-memory --max-total-tokens 120000` (rebased stack) | 0.842 (1319 q) | 0.839 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, MTP (EAGLE, 3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens) | 0.951, accept length 3.56 | 0.953, 3.56 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, DFlash draft | 0.951, accept length 5.42 | 0.952, 5.44 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PD (prefill TP1 + decode TP1, mooncake), unified, repeated runs | 0.952–0.960, no hang | 0.954–0.958 |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | PD (TP1 + TP1, mooncake), unified | 0.810 | 0.808 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, HiCache | 0.954 | — |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PP2, unified | 0.953 | 0.955 (static pools) |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified (500 q) | 0.958 | 0.960 |
| 2x B200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified, `trtllm_mha` (1319 q) | 0.849 | 0.863 |
| 2x B300 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B / openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified | 0.950 / 0.849 | 0.954 / 0.849 |

On B200 and B300, 40 greedy GSM8K generations were compared with `main`: 35–40 of 40 are identical, and the rest first differ after at least 27 characters (near ties). The H200 runs above other than the two marked "rebased stack" were run at the stack top before it was rebased onto the current base; the code they cover is unchanged by the rebase except for conflict resolutions.

The MTP and DFlash rows exercise draft placement by lifetime; the HiCache row exercises the host changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured at the stack top, same flags as `main` (bench_serving, random 4096-in / 512-out unless noted):

| Hardware | Model / configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b, unified, `--max-total-tokens 120000` | 3.93–3.95 req/s | 3.95 req/s |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B PD (TP1 + TP1), 2048-in / 256-out | 5.65–6.28 req/s | 6.21–6.29 req/s |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b PD (TP1 + TP1) | 9.39–9.45 req/s | 9.21 req/s |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B MTP TP2 / DFlash TP2 | 4.26 / 4.36 req/s | 4.29 / 4.35 req/s |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B TP2 / openai/gpt-oss-120b TP2 | 6.35 / 19.31 req/s | 6.34 / 19.28 req/s |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -373,3 +373,32 @@ def translate_token_ids(
         BLOCK=TRANSLATE_TOKEN_IDS_BLOCK,
     )
     return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def expand_page_mapping_kernel(
+    source, target, N: tl.constexpr, FACTOR: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr
+):
+    offsets = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    page = tl.load(source + offsets // FACTOR, mask=offsets < N - 1, other=0)
+    expanded = tl.where(page > 0, page * FACTOR + offsets % FACTOR, 0)
+    tl.store(
+        target + offsets, tl.where(offsets == N - 1, -1, expanded), mask=offsets < N
+    )
+
+
+def expand_page_mapping(source, target, factor):
+    """Refresh a stable replicated P-page map from the live owner-page map."""
+    if not target.is_cuda:
+        offsets = torch.arange(target.numel() - 1, device=target.device)
+        pages = source[offsets // factor]
+        target[:-1].copy_(torch.where(pages > 0, pages * factor + offsets % factor, 0))
+        target[-1] = -1
+        return
+    expand_page_mapping_kernel[(triton.cdiv(target.numel(), 256),)](
+        source,
+        target,
+        target.numel(),
+        factor,
+        256,
+    )
